description: Book a quoted shipment using any quote_id or option id returned from a quote tool (Warp or market carrier). Requires quote_id and the full delivery address with the delivery contact's name, phone and email, every time. Pickup can be omitted only when a default shipper is saved on the account. Collect any missing delivery details from the user BEFORE calling. Auth required.

accessorials.description: Pickup/delivery accessorial services. Should match the accessorials used when quoting.

delivery.description: Delivery accessorials: liftgate-delivery, residential-delivery, inside-delivery, limited-access-delivery, delivery-appointment

pickup.description: Pickup accessorials: liftgate-pickup, residential-pickup, inside-pickup, limited-access-pickup, pickup-appointment

delivery.description: Delivery address and delivery contact. Required on every booking, with every field: street, city, state, ZIP, contact name, phone and email. Warp never fills delivery from past shipments. Ask the user for anything missing before calling book.

email.description: Delivery contact email. Required by Warp on every booking: ask the user for it if you don't have it.

delivery_window.description: Delivery time window, 24h HH:MM, e.g. { from: '09:00', to: '12:00' }. Defaults to a full business day if omitted.

pickup.description: Pickup address. Required if no default shipper is saved on your account.

pickup_window.description: Pickup time window, 24h HH:MM, e.g. { from: '08:00', to: '17:00' }. Defaults to a full business day if omitted.

quote_id.description: Quote ID from warp_quote_id (Warp) or id field of any market option returned by a quote tool. Use the id from your MOST RECENT quote — market-option ids rotate on every quote call and stale ids are rejected.

name: book
title: Book Shipment
